heading: **22 March 2026**
body:
*SBP Histone Octamer Plate*

Split 8 mL of the prepared octamer into 83 uL per well of a 96-well plate. Then split into 20 uL per well of a 4ti384 well plate.

*PCR2 mix (6.5) plates*

![](assets/img/doc3-image15.png)

300 uL  per well of a Greiner Round PP plate → 3 X 4ti384 well plates

Top up the same plate and then prepare another 3 plates.

*Diluted TF plates*

Take 15 uL protein and add 75 uL of TF dilution buffer to make the final volume up to 90 uL.
title: SBP Histone Octamer Plate
